paragraphs: Zavdi ben Levi. Rabbi Yochanan said, “Zavdi ben Levi recited”: Zevachim 28b; Keritot 5a. Rabbi Hoshaya sent him: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Demai chapter 7. Rabbi Yose ben Petros; Rabbi Shalmon his brother (see his entry and Levi above). See Kohelet Rabbah, on “Whatever your hand finds”: he longed to see Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s face after his death. He appeared to him after death and showed him people whose faces were upright, with their learning in their hands ….
